bytes_scope: Backend/peer body bytes and client-to-observer HTTP message bytes; excludes TCP/IP and second proxy hop. Not SSD throughput.
file_occupancy_scope: Sampled live proxy directories only; excludes closed priming snapshots and older wave directories retained by the experiment. File lengths and allocated blocks are not logical payload occupancy or device I/O.
reconciliation: Every retained priming, measurement and replay phase reconciled exactly with its hashed raw ledger; all measured full canonical matrices matched nonempty HTTP200 reference Loki matrices.

manifest.aggregate_tier_attribution: unattributed; tier=l0 is a hot-key sidecar, not compatibility Tier0
manifest.backend_image_identity_scope: requested image references only; actual container image IDs must be captured separately
manifest.fixture_scope: independent disjoint per-cell shard groups; reference cache keys separate; backend chunk/OS caches may already be warm
manifest.namespace_claim_policy: persistent exclusive fixture+cell claim before any priming; reuse is rejected even after interrupted runs
manifest.observer_scope: paired ledger/wire active-response completion plus bounded500ms quiet period(up to3s) for asynchronous replica work
manifest.resource_scope: logical admission limits are not physical SSD caps; bbolt lengths/allocated blocks and GoSys/kernel Maxrss are separate; no per-semantic-layer allocator or occupancy inferred
manifest.timing_scope: descriptive instrumented same-host latency; other user services may contend; no universal speedup or scaling claim
manifest.unsupported_layer_metrics: null is unsupported/missing, never a measured zero
